verdict.rationale: stagewise's own docs index calls it "the open-source agentic IDE," and there is a public GitHub repository (stagewise-io/stagewise), so the source appears readable under an open-source model. However, no specific license is named or quoted, and the enterprise offering of self-hosting "the stagewise Cloud" leaves unclear whether every component is open. Missing for 10: the named open license (e.g. MIT, Apache, AGPL), confirmation that the full product including cloud components is open, and independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
